title: UI Timer Lib
description: A  simple UI timer for mod creators, made to be as easy to use a possible.
body: # UI Utils UI Utils is a small Fabric library that makes it easy to display simple HUD elements without having to write your own renderer. It is designed for mod developers who want a quick and lightweight way to show text and timers on the player's screen. Here is an example of this library in use. ### Features * Display custom text on the HUD * Show live countdown timers * Change text and background colors easily * Show and hide the overlay * Lightweight and easy to integrate into other mods ### Setting it up * Download the latest `ui-utils-.jar` from the Versions tab. * Add the JAR to your project dependencies. * Add UI Utils as a dependency in your mod. **fabric.mod.json** ```json { "depends": { "fabricloader": "*", "minecraft": "1.21.6", "ui-utils": "*" } } ``` * Import within your Java file. **Main.java** ```java import com.uitutils.UIUtils; ``` ### Usage * Show a labeled timer ```java UIUtils.show(String label, int seconds); ``` * Hide timer ```java UIUtils.hide(); ``` * Set timer value ```java UIUtils.setTime(int seconds); ``` * Set timer color (24-bit RGB hexadecimal integer) ```java UIUtils.setColor(int rgb); ``` * Set background color (24-bit RGB hexadecimal integer) ```java UIUtils.setBackground(int rgb); ``` ### Internal fields These fields exist for direct access but **are not required for normal usage**. * Query current HUD text string ```java UIUtils.text; ``` * Query countdown value in seconds ```java UIUtils.secondsRemaining; ``` * Query HUD visibility ```java UIUtils.visible; ``` * Query HUD text color ```java UIUtils.color; ``` * Query background color ```java UIUtils.background; ```
